# Best white-label voice AI agent platforms for agencies (2026)

If you're building an agency that sells AI receptionists, inbound call handling, appointment booking, lead qualification, or outbound calling under your own brand, I'd shortlist **Trillet, VoiceAIWrapper, HighLevel, Autocalls, and Stammer AI** first.

The biggest distinction is whether you want a ready-made platform you can rebrand and resell, or a developer platform that gives you more control but requires additional setup.

These recommendations are based on current published feature and pricing comparisons, checked in October 2026. Pricing and reseller terms can change, so confirm them before committing. [www.retellai.com](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.leadfriendly.com](https://www.leadfriendly.com/guides/white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms-compared?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.wixzel.com](https://www.wixzel.com/best/white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Top platforms at a glance

![The Voice Operating Layer | Trillet](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/CfWi8yVX6kQfSRVlBHGvpQUPI18wM3SmspLij3WdDPbNhoct5CiSQY9qaTSIYXfzSTdHOF-yJknm69YUhl2RaFlAeWStytKcW7kPVDO7glmtsRKxaIvKNjHCFdM4xKvFLowUpnT-jpv_qsxG89h0gfOMYFxHk2pgNHIYN5CumAFwkZCo78xbZd0UQnNcQ0yM?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Trillet

(Best overall starting point)

Published agency pricing: \$99–\$299/month

A hosted agency platform with white-label branding, client workspaces, and client billing. Its Agency tier is listed at \$299/month with unlimited workspaces and 3,000 included minutes in recent comparisons.

**Best for\:** Agencies wanting a straightforward way to launch and scale client accounts without assembling a complex tech stack.

Watch for: additional usage charges and telephony costs.

[Visit Trillet](https://trillet.ai/)

---

![Voice AI dashboard - voiceaiwrapper](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2J5MxR3IOlg0KKU2U-43m-nD8SkULjGHArZ447UipbDMITiasBQQkyB8f0YwuVjjzzH6sCFQdIoap-gqZ98cVKot1lt2f0pJfuRWWdSDHASAUxokTvBjZxhVWLQA1gDR2dR4_A0aOeijPIT1k2fu8XTnoUzUV2lN9FJtZdZs9ZsKNbWQVgLxhBZ4B-JIRnqu?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. VoiceAIWrapper

(Best for flexibility)

Published pricing: multiple tiers; verify current plan

A branded client portal that connects to underlying voice platforms such as Vapi and Retell. You can use different voice engines while presenting a consistent agency brand to clients.

**Best for\:** Technical agencies that want to choose their own AI models, voices, and call infrastructure.

Watch for: separate provider accounts, usage bills, and API-key management.

[Visit VoiceAIWrapper](https://voiceaiwrapper.com/)

---

![GoHighLevel CTI | RingCentral App Gallery](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/WFiya9aVBYRmY5v_4Ne1JDeFCoAnIgQFfmubtFCtQ96phLb2GBVjYBcGatR9w_xDa09_W9Z0KMDvaveSgFXQgZAFv5J6AlMW72DNbE-WQOxC9B0FvJmkscDB2_J9MPLhmrcEWj6R8oB5iSsFxnNVHXqMsjoz6xCZTrez7FMznF8Cvd50LyjClWzxB-A5rlPG?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. HighLevel

Agency Unlimited: \$297/month · Agency Pro: \$497/month

A broader CRM and marketing automation platform with AI voice capabilities, subaccounts, and SaaS-mode rebilling options on the appropriate plan.

**Best for\:** Agencies selling voice AI alongside CRM, automated follow-ups, SMS, funnels, missed-call recovery, and appointment booking.

Watch for: voice usage, AI Employee charges, and phone costs on top of the base subscription.

[Visit HighLevel](https://www.gohighlevel.com/)

---

![White Label Platform - Autocalls](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/G-7XiBwT26lu_7ZoaB2XS2RwriNJwaa-zPAXD-2A9gvWMb_l95wqgj-6vz2--H195PvMHqeM3fGZZL4De3ayKgyiVpuI7VjDE5Pl2J33K0E0jlnrTsDgLrAWIWhAoSlZw1nUgSM62x9hm0k-xujRq5g0Mc3ZUqExLQb9_jchdaLI36kYnvgJPLaBl6EbdpwZ?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. Autocalls

Agency White Label: \$419/month

An all-in-one platform with a custom-branded interface, client subaccounts, and Stripe rebilling. Its published comparison lists 3,500 included minutes and \$0.09 per additional minute.

**Best for\:** Agencies that prioritize a bundled, no-code experience and want to avoid managing several separate AI providers.

Watch for: whether the included minutes and bundled features fit your actual call volume.

[Visit Autocalls](https://autocalls.ai/)

---

![Best AI Agent for Call Centers: Build & Sell Your Own with Stammer AI](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5bld0M4KenjIs0YjUmtkM22ZYUMEl6ywpm5kbhYaomVv2rEQ76QPRBie7VCxfikQpaSG-1AIz9yUZzfQsZsWKTkXcsa_-2HhbEJcZDA_NG0ekwP72L_C7_eLNtn6Rh2zhK9vAjXgETRhq5I8Nie1s6OK75eGh4E6giV7vYPXknxDZuzwOblV4u576WwrLyCV?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. Stammer AI

White-label entry pricing reported around \$99/month

A white-label platform aimed at agencies reselling conversational AI, with voice and chatbot capabilities and usage-based charges.

**Best for\:** Smaller agencies looking to test an AI-agent offer without a large upfront platform commitment.

Watch for: included agent limits, voice model rates, and which features are available on the white-label tier.

[Visit Stammer AI](https://stammer.ai/)

Pricing and feature references: [autocalls.ai](https://autocalls.ai/article/best-white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[ainora.lt](https://ainora.lt/blog/best-white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms-agencies-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.retellai.com](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.leadfriendly.com](https://www.leadfriendly.com/guides/white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms-compared?utm_source=chatgpt.com) Vendor websites should be treated as the final authority on current terms.

## Which platform should you choose?

| If your priority is… | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Launching a white-label voice AI agency quickly | Trillet |
| Maximum flexibility over voice infrastructure | VoiceAIWrapper + Retell or Vapi |
| Selling AI calling plus CRM and marketing automation | HighLevel |
| Bundled voice AI with relatively predictable usage pricing | Autocalls |
| Testing an agency offer on a lower monthly fee | Stammer AI |
| Building a deeply customized product with developers | Retell AI or Vapi |


Retell and Vapi are primarily voice-agent infrastructure platforms, rather than complete white-label agency SaaS products. You can build a sophisticated solution with them, but you'll need to account for the branded client interface, client management, billing, and support layer yourself or through another product. [www.retellai.com](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.leadfriendly.com](https://www.leadfriendly.com/guides/white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms-compared?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.wixzel.com](https://www.wixzel.com/best/white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What matters most when comparing them

Before you sign up, check these six things\:

- **True white-labeling\:** Can you use your own domain, logo, and brand throughout the client dashboard?
- **Client separation\:** Does each client have separate agents, phone numbers, usage limits, and permissions?
- **Billing and markup\:** Can you set your own per-minute rates, monthly subscriptions, and overage charges?
- **Total cost per minute\:** Include telephony, speech recognition, voice generation, LLM usage, and platform fees—not just the advertised rate.
- **Call performance\:** Test latency, interruptions, accents, noisy environments, transfers, and booking accuracy using realistic calls.
- **Integrations and compliance\:** Check CRM integrations, call recording controls, consent and opt-out workflows, and applicable calling laws.

One important market change: Synthflow has been a popular agency option, but recent October 2026 comparisons report that its in-product reseller billing was removed in September 2026 and that new enterprise contracts start around \$30,000 annually. Verify its current terms before considering it. [www.retellai.com](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.leadfriendly.com](https://www.leadfriendly.com/guides/white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms-compared?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.wixzel.com](https://www.wixzel.com/best/white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[autocalls.ai](https://autocalls.ai/article/best-white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[ainora.lt](https://ainora.lt/blog/best-white-label-ai-voice-agent-platforms-agencies-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For a new agency, I'd start by comparing **Trillet vs. VoiceAIWrapper vs. HighLevel**\. They represent three different business models: a ready-made white-label voice product, a flexible voice platform with a branded portal, and an established CRM-centered agency business.

The right choice depends on how you intend to make money: recurring SaaS subscriptions, usage-based call billing, or a managed service with setup fees.

Want to narrow it down? [Compare true all-in monthly costs](f) Or [Find the best platform for my agency model](f)
